[[Quickroot]] is a [[Pinesoul]] [[boss]] in the [[Lornar's Pass]] who spawns with 3 or 4 [[Ice Imp]]s.

== Locations ==
* [[Southern Shiverpeaks]]
** {{NPC location|Lornar's Pass}}

== Skills ==
16 [[Protection Prayers]]
* {{Skill icon|Life Barrier}} ([[elite]])
* {{Skill icon|Pacifism}}
* {{Skill icon|Reversal of Fortune}}

== Items dropped ==
* [[Alpine Seed]]

== Notes ==
* Quickroot can be most easily found by entering Lornar's Pass from [[Beacon's Perch]]. He will be just off-radar to the left, on top of the hill. He shares this spawning location with [[Clobberhusk]], [[Poisonbough]], and non-boss [[Pinesoul]]s, so it may be necessary to [[zone]] a few times in order to find him. It might be a good idea to check the two topmost spawnpoints each time you enter Lornar's Pass.
* He is hard to kill with the low level [[henchmen]] from [[Beacon's Perch]], so it is recommended that you bring [[hero]]es or have a friend with heroes help you.
